title: Lean Back
year_note: The year is the original's. This recording is an AI-made soul cover posted on YouTube, and its upload title is all we know about it.

titles: Fat Joe -  Lean Back (Soul’d Out Version)

notes.made: Scott Storch, the former Roots keyboardist, made the beat with Fat Joe in about 15 minutes, by Storch's account; Joe asked for something a little Arabian, like the film Belly, and for a big intro, which became the horror-movie strings. Joe cut three verses, then Remy Ma insisted on a place and he dropped one of his to make room. It was recorded at Jerusalem Studios in Miami and mixed at The Hit Factory Criteria.
notes.context: Terror Squad had lost Big Pun to a heart attack in early 2000, and Fat Joe had rebuilt with the number-two 'What's Luv?'. The hook is about the rockaway, a dance where you barely move and lean back. It went to number one on August 21, 2004, for three weeks, held number one R&B for seven, and Lil Jon's crunk remix with Eminem and Mase probably helped push it there.

listen_for.note: Storch's dramatic strings, built because Joe wanted a big entrance.
Remy Ma's verse, the one she demanded and Joe made room for.
a chanted dance instruction over the Eastern-sounding keyboard line, not a sung melody, so a soul singer has to find one.

leads_to.title: Still Not a Player
leads_to.why: Terror Squad's first crossover, on Brenda Russell's 'A Little Bit of Love', by the member who wasn't there for 'Lean Back'.

notes.unverified: I didn't confirm a Grammy nomination for 'Lean Back'.

culture.title: Three weeks at number one
culture.line: Number one on the Hot 100 from August 21, 2004, and number 10 for the whole year.
